description: Python script for downloading and repacking GitHub archive tarballs, including handling of commit timestamps, hash verification, and submodule checks.

classes.name: Path
classes.description: Context manager for directory preparation, cleanup, and tarball operations.

classes.name: DownloadGitHubTarball
classes.description: Handles downloading, verifying, and repacking GitHub archive tarballs with commit timestamp caching.

classes.name: PathException
classes.description: Custom exception for Path class errors.

classes.name: DownloadGitHubError
classes.description: Custom exception for errors during GitHub tarball download process.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for Path class, initializes directory context parameters.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enters context, optionally cleans directory and creates it.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Exits context, optionally cleans up directory.

methods.name: untar
methods.description: Extracts tarball into a directory, expecting a single subdirectory.

methods.name: tar
methods.description: Creates a tarball from a directory or subdirectory.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached commit timestamp for a given key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a commit timestamp for a given key.
